players.product: AI data center power: sidecar (out-of-rack) power, in-rack power supplies for centralized and distributed architectures, energy-storage compensation; SST in development

quarterly_data.signal: R&D project table (annual report): the MHP380 variable-frequency drive is in development for the next-generation AI data center 800V high-voltage DC architecture, addressing the power-supply bottleneck of 600kW~1MW rack-level compute; the goal is a drive that fits the future 800V power-supply architecture so customers can select it directly in the new architecture without further power conversion. The company expects it to round out its machine-room air-conditioning products and complete its 800V platform line-up.
quarterly_data.figure: MHP380 drive for 800V HVDC architecture (600kW~1MW racks), in development
